scope: Updated Phase 1 draft JSON, approved-policy consistency, local references, JSON Schema 2020-12, examples, selected OpenAPI structure, and preservation checks only. No API/worker/renderer implementation or runtime integration tests.

checks.name: All twelve recommendations approved without authorizing implementation
Canonical nine-template registry agrees with policy
Initial five templates remain subject to tests
Legacy scene aliases are not silently accepted
Measured 720p 30 FPS profile and five-second tolerance
No speech clipping speedup or scene overlap
Clean MP4 and private WebVTT sidecar policy
Caption asset kind and MIME type are documented
Generation publication requires separate caption reference
Caption delivery reuses authorized asset route
Initial voice and visual profile remain controlled
Exact runtime and voice remain unselected pending tests
Approved idempotency replay is twenty-four hours
Route target belongs in request identity not uniqueness namespace
Approved initial demo capacity and quota values
Quota wire limit reports configuration while defaulting to three
One slot reservation and durable render-start evidence
Approved quota settlement distinguishes cancellation timing
Pipeline duration/validation failure releases its reservation
Approved heartbeat lease and attempt test defaults
Cancellation requires process stop and bounded recovery
Nonretryable revision failures cannot trigger same-snapshot fresh work
Late cancellation evidence is evidence-only for pre-cancel work
Positive late-evidence fixture has coherent pre-cancel timestamps and lease
No unbenchmarked stage timeout or duration SLA invented
Private local delivery with deferred remote redirects
Approved temporary and paired export retention
Private provenance separates inputs and publication
Approved password bounds are fifteen to one hundred twenty-eight
Approved access and refresh session lifetimes
Same-origin secure cookie CSRF policy without localStorage tokens
Settings require reapproval while title-only edits preserve it
Lifecycle vocabulary agrees with shared job schema
Empty/binary exception has no JSON envelope: POST /auth/logout 204
Empty/binary exception has no JSON envelope: GET /assets/{assetId}/download 302

examples.name: Complete reviewed workflow publishes video and captions
Running cancellation request is not cancellation completion
Queued cancellation request does not start execution
Internal lease is separate from polling
Completed jobs cannot also contain failure errors
Queued job has no prior execution claim
Flattened legacy pipeline label is not a job status
Owner cannot be set by client
Structurally valid publication with unready/unowned video or caption must fail service checks
Structurally valid start using unapproved storyboard must fail service checks
Completed caption reference cannot be null
Unpublished caption reference is not exposed on a running job
Automatic execution attempts are capped at two
Logical WebVTT cue payload shares timeline
Internal cancellation before actual renderer start
Internal first render-start evidence survives a reclaim
Exactly one slot is reserved per new admission
A consumed reservation has a stable job link
A released reservation has a stable job link
A longer duration does not reserve two slots
Published clean MP4 and caption pair share seven-day expiry
Wrong caption timeline hash is structurally valid but semantically rejected
Wrong publication expiry is structurally valid but semantically rejected
Historical COMPLETED is retained after paired assets expire
Cancellation winning before completion prevents later publication
Late cancellation after a reclaim cannot refund prior render work
Replaying a receipt does not re-run capacity checks or reserve twice
A repeated terminal reservation settlement cannot count twice
Duration mismatch is a nonretryable pipeline failure
Known nonretryable duration failure cannot create a same-snapshot retry
Known revision-required snapshot cannot bypass retry guard via new start
Pre-cancel render evidence can arrive after cancellation accepted
Post-cancel launch is not legitimate pre-cancel render evidence
Reject worker timing in planned scene
Duplicate scene IDs need semantic validation
Unknown flow endpoint needs semantic validation
Reject planner millisecond timing fields on internal timeline
Logical WebVTT sidecar from canonical timeline

limitations: No dedicated full OpenAPI document validator is installed; selected structural checks are not a complete OAS conformance certification.
Schema-only checks do not establish ownership, unique scene IDs, cross-resource consistency, duration sums, quota accounting or state-transition correctness.
No features were enabled and no API handlers, database models, queues or rendering code were implemented.
